scope: All105 local archive map rule exports. No donor script execution. Patch only explicitly named supported settings; absent labels retain session defaults.
priority: net_rules defaults < map patch < explicit host overrides. READY patch is temporary and must not persist personal settings.
mode_precedence: On death AutoRespawn => respawn; On death Eliminate + Revive teammates on => revive; BRArena/BRRules fallback => revive. Generic DeathMatch label never overrides elimination semantics.
notes: Player speed maps only walk: ASHFALL walk base already scales both normal and sprint speed, while run multiplies sprint gain. Mapping both would multiply the authored factor twice. Flight/fling/gravity are not inferred.
Source elimination Win at score is never mapped to kill cap; revive patch disables kill cap.
Unknown settings and custom scripts retained verbatim as unsupported.
Damage above300% and other values exceeding supported net_rules1000 limits are explicitly clamped and recorded.
No source setting labels available for26maps; their patches are empty.
